summary: Nelson Roofing Salt Lake City (nelsonroofingslc.com) is an Established (Digital Maturity 69) roofing contractor with strong search and reputation signals but clear enquiry friction. DeterministicAssessment OpportunityScore 56 / confidence 90 flags the mainIssue 'Enquiry friction' - 'The first website form asks for many details at once.' Audit is Partial but confirms solid SEO and technical health, leaving focused conversion and accessibility improvements as the priority.

topOpportunities.title: Reduce initial form friction
topOpportunities.evidence: DeterministicAssessment mainIssue: 'Enquiry friction' with issueDetail: 'The first website form asks for many details at once.' and Form field count on homepage: 12
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: 12 fields at first contact can deter mobile users from starting an estimate request, even though demand signals are strong.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Test a 2-step enquiry: shorten first step to name/phone/address or zip + roof need with clear 'Online estimates offered' CTA, keeping full details for step 2. Use existing GA4 to measure start vs completion.

topOpportunities.title: Complete image alt text for accessibility
topOpportunities.evidence: Image alt-text coverage: 68% with 47 images observed on homepage and Accessibility 89 per measuredAudit
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Improves accessibility score from 89 and helps search understanding without design changes.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Add descriptive alt text to the ~32% of homepage images missing it (47 images total). Prioritize hero, service, and before/after images for screen readers and SEO.

topOpportunities.title: Clarify and improve mobile experience
topOpportunities.evidence: mobileQuality: 'Fair' in measuredAudit and Responsive viewport detected but Lighthouse status: Failed (ERR_LAUNCHER_PATH_NOT_SET - not measured)
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Most roofing estimate requests start on mobile; a Fair experience plus long forms can reduce completions.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Review mobile experience given 'Fair' rating: check tap targets, form usability with 12 inputs, and page speed on Webflow template. Re-run Lighthouse once Chrome path is available to quantify performance.

topOpportunities.title: Close sitemap vs crawl coverage gap
topOpportunities.evidence: Crawled 10 same-site pages and checked 17 internal links with sitemapPageCount: 16 and pagesCrawled: 10 (truncated: true) and Internal links observed on homepage: 16
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Helps ensure service and location pages are found by search and visitors; currently 16 in sitemap but only 10 crawled in sample.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Ensure all 16 sitemap pages are discoverable via internal links (only 10 crawled in 10-page limit). Strengthen interlinking from homepage and service pages (roof-replacement, roof-repair, emergency-roof-repair etc) to location pages like /south-salt-lake.
